chapters.title: Chapter 1880
paragraphs: When Noah began forging his First Dimension, a wondrous phenomenon played out as it was hard to say how many beings grasped exactly what it meant!
One could say its effects were null or another could say that they were far reaching and they could both be right- but the crucial thing was that it had occurred.
On Noah's chest, the visage of Lavalliere that had branded itself to Noah was also shining with utter glory at this moment.

Around her very being, there were tendrils of chains from many sources as the major ones were from Destiny, Fate, Karma, and Fortune. There were also profound chains buzzing with the Dream Essence that began to shine at this moment, their brighter sheen shockingly causing some of them to begin shattering into sandy light that surged back into Lavalliere herself!
Her will surged with shock at this scene as even without consuming mountains of unique items or relics, she felt her authority returning- even if it was ever so slowly!
Yet Noah continued forging forward even amidst all this.
HOONG!

An explosive force emanated from his blooming Seed as one could see this circular structure shockingly unfolding, the concentration of Dream Essence reaching tremendous levels as the circular Origins became planar.

Essence was drawn from the surroundings and the Infinite Reality Passages as the Seed bloomed into a Dimension- this process happening slowly as the end result of it all would be an endless golden flat plain!
A plain that Noah would have to continue expanding until it reached a shocking level of saturation- and only then could he even think of beginning to form a second Seed to bloom a second Dimension.

The process was somewhat slow in Noah's eyes as it wasn't completed in just seconds, his Paramount Kainos Dream Dimensional Reality taking its time to draw in essence and unfurl from the Seed as it established itself.
And of course, if one was establishing a Dimension...
<The essence of the Decretum of the Dream Dimension begins to bloom within your Origin.>
Yes!
An Origin has to have governing laws and structures to come to fruition, and one could not be built if it did not have a Decretum holding it stable!
So among the many boons Noah would have, one of them was the ridiculous fact that he would begin to understand the Decretum of any Dimension he established whether he had the talent for it or not.
<When the First Dimension is successfully established, understanding in the Decretum of the Dream Dimension shall bloom.>
Vast and magisterial authority that exceeded Daos or Edicts and seemed to be on the same level as Natural Laws of Reality bloomed within Noah.

His Origin, Soul, and Body continued their resonance as every part of them was expanding, Noah's very molecular structure becoming altered in shocking ways as since it was taking time, Noah's will gazed at the changes that had already completed first.
And the one to complete the fastest...were his eyes!
His glorious eyes that shone with the light of boundless suns, the colors Blue, Gold, and Crimson shooting out as incandescent beams of light.
It was the authority of the Tri-Pupiled Kainos Emperor.

<Tri-Pupiled Kainos Emperor>:: An authority that distinguishes the one to have attained eyes that exceed most if not all beings of this Era. The gaze of the Tri-Pupiled Kainos Emperor is far reaching as at the very least, it can allow you to obtain the identity of an existence, their level of power, their True Vitality and Resource Values, all the way to their innermost secrets and concepts they cultivate depending on their level of power. The eyes of the Tri-Pupiled Kainos Emperor can also easily see the abstruse and hard to grasp concept around it, making it a matter of them for them to comprehend the workings of Natural Laws of Reality to even the Decretums of Dimensions. They can cause the descent of <Essence Destabilization> in the surroundings as all sources of essence become Chaotic and uncontrollable, bringing to fruition Essence Storms that can decimate weak beings depending on their level of strength. Essence Storms vary from the weakest Elemental Storms to the strongest Natural Law Storms and Decretum Storms...

<...The Will of the Tri-Pupiled Kainos Emperor can be channeled from his eyes and release destructive attacks, with any abilities cast through the eyes granted 5,000 base True Dimensional Dream Damage Values, granted the effect of AOE Dream Dimensional Splash Damage, and being able to target wherever the eyes of the Tri-Pupiled Kainos Emperor are gazing at. The Tri-Pupiled Kainos Emperor can also gaze upon those around him and break down their concepts, being able to copy their concepts and understandings up to the level of TABOO. Once a week, you can Deconstruct a concept up to the tier of DHARMA, or deconstruct the understandings of Natural Laws or Decretum of a Dimension when certain unique conditions based on the target selected are met. The Fate, Destiny, Karma, and Fortune of others can be seen with but a gaze- their level being quantified on a scale of 1-100 from lowest to highest. Those with low levels of Fate, Destiny, Karma, and Fortune will more easily be dominated by your will. Lastly, a sense of shocking wonder and beauty emanates from your eyes as gazing into them for too long can increase the favorability others feel towards you, while increasing the animosity of your chosen enemies. The authority of the Tri-Pupiled Kainos Emperor is still calculating its limits as new functions will be unlocked over time...>
There were no words that could be said about Noah's eyes!
They were simply too ridiculous as they came with too many things, one of the more unique ones being the level of information Noah could attain from his surroundings.
The identity of all things, and the quantification of the Values of those he gazed at.

It even went as far as being capable to quantify one's True Vitality Values and Resource Values, where Noah could see the 'Health' and Mana of his enemies, and even what their Maximum Reserves of Dream Essence, Essence of Reality, or any other types of Essence!
They were dazzling eyes of pure wonder.
And yet this was merely their first function.

One of the more astounding functions they held...was allowing Noah to more easily grasp the Natural Laws of Reality and the Decretum of a Dimension, and going even further as to allow him to deconstruct such concepts from an enemy- even if it was once a week and with certain conditions being met!
Unique conditions that would change with every target he selected.
What would be the conditions to deconstruct anything from the Dimensional Deceiver, Lillith?!

chapters.title: Chapter 1881
paragraphs: The authority of the Tri-Pupiled Kainos Emperor was astounding enough as it opened up many avenues for Noah, but this was merely the first of the many surprises to come.

As Noah's Seed unfurled into a planar Dimension, his 10 Trillion Kainos Royal Dream Cosmos suffused with light as close to half began to turn into dazzling liquified masses that washes over the golden lands below, causing waves of sandy gold light to begin forming over the golden earth much similar to the genuine Dream Dimension!
But unlike the genuine Dimension, other golden Cosmos remained in the skies while rotating- the ones that had liquified very soon being replenished as the Essence from False Grotto Nacres surged in.

Boundless golden light was surging all around as gradually, the unfurling seed would very soon be fully bloomed- but this process of advancement once more had other concepts of Noah's advancing first as they utilized the raging bestowment of essence and authority to advance forward.
After his Tri-Pupiled Kainos Emperor authority, the Traits that took the bestowing of authority for themselves came forward!
<The Authority of the Infinite Mana Trait has greatly increased.>
Vast waves of cerulean blue light surged around Noah's body seated upon the Throne of Unnamed Tyranny, pure Mana blaring from him senselessly and forming into a Mana storm as more prompts came down!
<Skill Succession has been unlocked.>
<Resource Master has been unlocked.>
<Concept Amalgamation has been unlocked.>
Noah's will blazed wildly as something wondrous budded off from the Trait of Infinite Mana.
His mind nigh instantly computed the stellar changes brought forward as his Tri-Pupiled eyes spun with maddening Tyranny!

<Skill Succession>:: When casting an ability, a second ability can be linked to it to be cast at the same time as the second ability's resource cost is replaced by pure Mana. Compatible abilities can bring forth unexpected resonance and greatly increase the Damage of linked abilities.

<Resource Master>:: Though Mana may be the only thing Infinite, this is not a permanent limitation. Once a day for 3 microseconds, you can replace any Resource to have the Infinite effect of Mana. The time scale relates to the location this ability is activated in as it supersedes the effects of time dilation.

<Concept Amalgamation>:: Skills can be combined, and so can concepts once enough pure Mana is provided. Compatible Daos and Nomological Edicts can be combined to form Ascendant Daos and Nomological Edicts. When enough experience is gained through the Amalgamation of Daos and Nomological Edicts, the Amalgamation of even more pristine concepts can become possible.
BOOM!
Noah's mind buzzed as it felt like something was greatly expanded!
Fantastical authority descended as the Trait of Infinite Mana did not disappoint, coming up with three new features.

Since it would be game over for all beings if Noah had more than just Mana be Infinite, he was granted <Resource Master> that would give him just a feeling of having other Pristine resources be Infinite for 3 microseconds.

And if he used the authority of this ability in the outside Realities or Dimensions, it didn't mean he could somehow rely on the Time Dilation effects of the Dimensional Holy Land to be in this stage for tens of thousands of microseconds!

The moment he tried to utilize this authority in an area affected by Time Dilation, it would ignore the effects and simply run out its 3 Microseconds in that location. It superseded the bounds of time to make sure Noah couldn't abuse it.
Then, there were the wonders of <Skill Succession> and <Concept Amalgamation> that only seemed to propel Noah's power upwards.
Both were things Noah had to put some time and theorize in as they were pathways for unlocking unheard of levels of strength!
Then came Noah's next Trait.
<The Authority of the Protagonist Trait has greatly increased.>
A gorgeous allure of regal purple gold light washed over Noah as needed prompts rained down.
<Protagonist's Symphony has been unlocked.>
<In The Darkest Hour has been unlocked.>
<I Am The Main Character has been unlocked.>

The Protagonist Trait came with its own surprises as its past features were bolstered in authority somewhat, but much of this authority was clustered around the three new features that glimmered with pure wonder.

<Protagonist's Symphony>:: As a Protagonist, fanfare follows you wherever you go. During the events throughout your life, a symphony shall begin to play to convey the gravity or wonders of the current situation- each time with differing effects. During tough battles, a symphony unique to you shall begin resonating across the domain space you are in as your enemies are granted the Demoralized Side Character Debuff that lowers their Damage and Defense Values, Resource Generation, Vitality Regeneration, and Cast and Movement speed by 25%. Meanwhile, allies are granted the Chosen Extra Buff as they attain 25% increased Damage and Defense Values, Resource Generation, Vitality Regeneration, and Cast and Movement Speed. When constructing Daos, Edicts, or other concepts, a Symphony unique to such an event will play as the speed of construction and success of a new concept will increase. The uses and applications of the Protagonist's Symphony are many as effects will continue to differ depending on the situation....

<In the Darkest Hour>:: When your True Vitality Values reach below 25%, your strength begins to progressively rise and only increase exponentially the closer you are to death. Even the formation of concepts, understanding of concepts, and epiphanies have a higher likelihood of occurring. A Protagonist can be under the threat of death, but he must never fall. Keep on fighting! Make a breakthrough amidst tough battles!
<I Am the Main Character>::???...
Ridiculous abilities bloomed under the Protagonist Trait as the last one didn't even have a proper description!
Its name was grandiose enough as <Protagonist's Symphony> and <In the Darkest Hour> provided Noah with yet another pathway of increased versatility and power.
He was expectant to see the remaining elevation of authorities as before Noah could even get to the third Trait though...
HOOONG!
He will focused on his Origin to see the budding seed finishing being termed this way, completely blooming and flattening out into a Dimensional plain.

It seemed like a grand golden earth that had paradisiacal sandy gold waves of light surging above this earth, the allure of spinning Kainos Royal Dream Cosmos mixing among the sandy gold waves of light as if Noah could describe it, he would only be able to call it beautiful!
<The Paramount Kainos Dream Dimensional Reality has been established.>
BZZZT!
<Preliminary understanding of the Decretum of Dream begins to bud within your soul.>

chapters.title: Chapter 1882
paragraphs: As soon as the First Dimension was established, Noah felt as if the boundless shackles that held him came loose.
His body felt as if it had been bound towards the ground this whole time as now, he grew wings and began soaring to the skies!
<Preliminary understanding of the Decretum of Dream begins to bud within your soul.>
The moment the first Dimension was established, this prompt bloomed as Noah's Soul stirred.
It felt a sense of longing and power it had not come across before- of an authority it had seen but never grasped until now.
It was...a Decretum of a Dimension.
What was a Decretum of a Dimension?
It was the fundamental ruling and ordinance of a Dimension as there were 9 Decretums based on the 9 Dimensions!
Those with high achievements in a Decretum wielded immense power as they could borrow the very strength of a Dimension, an example being the visage of Ezekiel who wielded the Decretum of Avalon.
Just with the understanding of this Decretum and other unique means, he could match Beta Strata LEGENDS while in the Ninth Firmament of Ascendancy.

It was something that allowed one to use Dimensional Essence in shocking means, with a more transparent example being the fact that beings with high attainments in the Decretum of Dream could perform feats akin to the Dream Inversion Baubles- capable of turning Dream into Reality!
Other Dimensional essences had their own uniqueness with their Decretums as this was a field no lesser than the Natural Laws of Reality.
It was heavy and pristine, and it descended onto Noah at this moment as he faced other prompts due to the fundamental changes his body had undergone.
<Your Paramount Kainos Dream Dimensional Reality now grants a TOTAL base addition of 20,000 Dimensional Dream Damage and Defense Values.>
<Your Reserves of the Essence of Reality have been elevated to the Maximum of 20 Million.>
<Your Affinity to the Natural Laws of Reality has risen greatly.>
<Your Affinity to the Natural Laws of Reality has risen greatly!>
BOOOM!

Unbelievable wonder bloomed as Noah intricately felt that his soul was smoothly linked across his Origin and Body, the paradisiacal planar Dimension with its edges surrounded by golden mist that he had to continue expanding in order to fully saturate also being covered by his Soul.

The golden Kainos Royal Dream Cosmos spun with boundless fervor amidst the sandy gold waves of Dream Essence, the earth of his Dimension also forming golden sand dunes and mountains as a shocking concentration of essence was budding all around!
The stellar light of purple and blue shone from the mainly gold Cosmos as this...was a mixture of a Dimension and Reality even though it was a type of a Dimension.
It was similar to the Dream Dimension...and at the same time it was not as it was something unique to Noah!
His figure turned increasingly glorious and beautiful upon his Throne of Unnamed Tyranny as the solidified crown sitting upon the backbone of another throne behind him lit up.

More points of light surged on this structure of a throne as it was hard to grasp the true significance of Noah's progress in terms of Authority as he didn't know just what was needed to enact a full throne of Authority!
But he settled with what he had for now as when he gazed back at his own throne that he sat on, a thought rose in his mind.
"You....also cannot remain Unnamed any longer."
WAA!
He thought of himself.
He thought of the Bloodline he had yet to grant a name that assimilated all other Bloodlines he received.
Surging destiny began to whip around him when he began to ponder upon this while more prompts came down due to the changes in his body!
<Your Dream Dimensional Body's Innate Dimensional Barrier is now equivalent to 300% of the highest reachable Defense Values in your strongest form.>

<Your Dream Dimensional Sea can more profoundly resonate with nature, the formation of TABOO concepts becoming 10,000% faster as the Natural Laws of Reality and Decretums of Dimensions become clearer in your eyes. The slow process of isolating the essence of a single Natural Law of Reality can be undertaken by your soul to begin the procession towards DHARMA.>
Preposterous levels of power were granted to his Body as his Innate Dimensional Barrier alone would be three times his strongest achievable Defense Value!
And the formation of Seeds of TABOO...Noah needed a few days to do it before as now, he should only need a few hours if not less than an hour to bring one to fruition.
This was on top of the thousands of TABOO Nomological Edict he had gained from the tens of thousands of Primogenial Strata LEGENDS he had killed, not to mention the boundless loot to come.

His power had grown to a terrifying level as he needed to quantify and gaze upon himself to see just how grand his changes were and what level of power he could reach now, but it seemed like the surprises were not done
To top it all off...
The cherry on the top...!
<Your Maximum Number of Ascendancy Halos is now 120.>
Glorious.
This was the only word that could describe this current phenomenon!
60 new Slots of Ascendancy Halos to fill as he had the TABOO Edicts to fill every single one.

What profound changes would occur with purely 60 TABOO Nomological Edicts into a single Halo? And for Noah to replace all of his Ascendancy Halos with only TABOO Edicts? What exactly would be the grand increase in authority?!
There were many aspects of Noah that needed to be quantified, but they would have to wait.
This was because his will couldn't stop gazing at his throne that retained the name of the Throne of Unnamed Tyranny.
Unnamed.
His Kainos Emperor Bloodline still remained Unnamed to this very day!
What name could he grant it that best signified him?
The easiest options that rose up were the Infinite Kainos Emperor or the Interminable Kainos Emperor.
Both had meanings of boundlessness as they applied to his Mana and somewhat applied to his Dimensional Reality, but...it wasn't a word that truly defined who he was.
He was not boundless in this unfolding Kainos Era.
He was not interminable!
What he wanted to be in this unfolding Kainos Era...was an unmatched Emperor that others could not compare to.
He wanted to be an ideal embodiment of an Emperor of this Era as nobody could take his Throne from him!
When he thought of a word that could best relate to being the ideal embodiment of something...a single one came to mind.
"Quintessential."
HOOONG!
Vibrant storms of destiny began to rage the moment he uttered this word out loud.
Others in his position may have favored Tyrannical or Infinite.
But that was them, and he was him. He was Noah Osmont, the...
"Quintessential Kainos Emperor."
WAA!
Quintessential meaning ideal, epitome, paragon, or the Embodiment of a Kainos Emperor!
He wanted to be the ideal embodiment of this Kainos Era.
Someone that other Emperors would gaze upon and instantly feel their inadequacy!
Instantly feel that they were wasting their time even competing with him!
For he would be the ideal Emperor of this current Era!
Of this current Age!
DIIING!
The storms of destiny picked up and became maddeningly tyrannical as Karma, Fortune, and Fate began to run wild as well.
They surged from his body that was situated upon the Throne of Quintessential Tyranny- the Throne that best exemplified Tyranny!
They surged outwards across the bounds of his Dimensional Holy Land.
Across the Infinite Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality.
...and these waves of Destiny, Fate, Karma, and Fortune continued to spread out across the vast Realities as it seemed Noah's mere designation of his name had caused an eruption of something unknown!

Whether it was coincidental or simply as someone that acted as a spark, his designation of name and authority seemed to resonate with the surrounding Natural Laws and very structure of Realities as it didn't necessarily mean it was all due to his actions, but one could not deny his involvement.

The buzzing waves of authority spread out across the vast Realities as in a shockingly short period of time...they even went to bathe the bounds of Dimensions as this was not in any way the authority of a single being!
It was something more pristine that even Noah couldn't fathom as it spread out to cover all the Domains that Candidate Emperors of the Kainos Era weaved in.
When it covered the vast domains, it released glorious bursts of information to all beings pertinent to it.
To all Candidate Emperors across Realities and Dimensions!
<The Authority of the Kainos Era has advanced and begun proliferating.>
BOOM!
<The Name of the First Age of the Kainos Era has come to fruition.>
Bursts of such words bloomed in the minds of Candidate Emperors of the Kainos Era- whether they were weak beings in the Firmaments of Ascendancy or even those past the Grotto Haven Stages!
The same words buzzed in Noah's mind as they told of the name of this Age that everyone was in!
In the Olden Era, there were the Age of Destiny, Age of Misery, Age of Chaos, Age of Fortune...and many other Ages where many Emperors rose and fell.
The Last Age of the Olden Era that OPPENHEIMER ended was the Age of Destiny.
Nobody knew how the names of the Ages of an Era came to be, and even fewer were privy to this secret over the Ages!
But at this moment, the name of the First Age of the Kainos Era bloomed before Noah's eyes and the eyes of countless others.
<The Age of Quintessence has arrived!>

His body felt as if it had been bound towards the ground this whole time as now, he grew wings and began soaring to the skies!
<Preliminary understanding of the Decretum of Dream begins to bud within your soul.>
The moment the first Dimension was established, this prompt bloomed as Noah's Soul stirred.
It felt a sense of longing and power it had not come across before- of an authority it had seen but never grasped until now.
It was...a Decretum of a Dimension.
What was a Decretum of a Dimension?
It was the fundamental ruling and ordinance of a Dimension as there were 9 Decretums based on the 9 Dimensions!
Those with high achievements in a Decretum wielded immense power as they could borrow the very strength of a Dimension, an example being the visage of Ezekiel who wielded the Decretum of Avalon.
Just with the understanding of this Decretum and other unique means, he could match Beta Strata LEGENDS while in the Ninth Firmament of Ascendancy.

It was something that allowed one to use Dimensional Essence in shocking means, with a more transparent example being the fact that beings with high attainments in the Decretum of Dream could perform feats akin to the Dream Inversion Baubles- capable of turning Dream into Reality!
Other Dimensional essences had their own uniqueness with their Decretums as this was a field no lesser than the Natural Laws of Reality.
It was heavy and pristine, and it descended onto Noah at this moment as he faced other prompts due to the fundamental changes his body had undergone.
<Your Paramount Kainos Dream Dimensional Reality now grants a TOTAL base addition of 20,000 Dimensional Dream Damage and Defense Values.>
<Your Reserves of the Essence of Reality have been elevated to the Maximum of 20 Million.>
<Your Affinity to the Natural Laws of Reality has risen greatly.>
<Your Affinity to the Natural Laws of Reality has risen greatly!>
BOOOM!

Unbelievable wonder bloomed as Noah intricately felt that his soul was smoothly linked across his Origin and Body, the paradisiacal planar Dimension with its edges surrounded by golden mist that he had to continue expanding in order to fully saturate also being covered by his Soul.

The golden Kainos Royal Dream Cosmos spun with boundless fervor amidst the sandy gold waves of Dream Essence, the earth of his Dimension also forming golden sand dunes and mountains as a shocking concentration of essence was budding all around!
The stellar light of purple and blue shone from the mainly gold Cosmos as this...was a mixture of a Dimension and Reality even though it was a type of a Dimension.
It was similar to the Dream Dimension...and at the same time it was not as it was something unique to Noah!
His figure turned increasingly glorious and beautiful upon his Throne of Unnamed Tyranny as the solidified crown sitting upon the backbone of another throne behind him lit up.

More points of light surged on this structure of a throne as it was hard to grasp the true significance of Noah's progress in terms of Authority as he didn't know just what was needed to enact a full throne of Authority!
But he settled with what he had for now as when he gazed back at his own throne that he sat on, a thought rose in his mind.
"You....also cannot remain Unnamed any longer."
WAA!
He thought of himself.
He thought of the Bloodline he had yet to grant a name that assimilated all other Bloodlines he received.
Surging destiny began to whip around him when he began to ponder upon this while more prompts came down due to the changes in his body!
<Your Dream Dimensional Body's Innate Dimensional Barrier is now equivalent to 300% of the highest reachable Defense Values in your strongest form.>

<Your Dream Dimensional Sea can more profoundly resonate with nature, the formation of TABOO concepts becoming 10,000% faster as the Natural Laws of Reality and Decretums of Dimensions become clearer in your eyes.
The slow process of isolating the essence of a single Natural Law of Reality can be undertaken by your soul to begin the procession towards DHARMA.>
Preposterous levels of power were granted to his Body as his Innate Dimensional Barrier alone would be three times his strongest achievable Defense Value!
And the formation of Seeds of TABOO...Noah needed a few days to do it before as now, he should only need a few hours if not less than an hour to bring one to fruition.
This was on top of the thousands of TABOO Nomological Edict he had gained from the tens of thousands of Primogenial Strata LEGENDS he had killed, not to mention the boundless loot to come.

His power had grown to a terrifying level as he needed to quantify and gaze upon himself to see just how grand his changes were and what level of power he could reach now, but it seemed like the surprises were not done
To top it all off...
The cherry on the top...!
<Your Maximum Number of Ascendancy Halos is now 120.>
Glorious.
This was the only word that could describe this current phenomenon!
60 new Slots of Ascendancy Halos to fill as he had the TABOO Edicts to fill every single one.
What profound changes would occur with purely 60 TABOO Nomological Edicts into a single Halo?
And for Noah to replace all of his Ascendancy Halos with only TABOO Edicts?
What exactly would be the grand increase in authority?!
There were many aspects of Noah that needed to be quantified, but they would have to wait.
This was because his will couldn't stop gazing at his throne that retained the name of the Throne of Unnamed Tyranny.
Unnamed.
His Kainos Emperor Bloodline still remained Unnamed to this very day!
What name could he grant it that best signified him?
The easiest options that rose up were the Infinite Kainos Emperor or the Interminable Kainos Emperor.
Both had meanings of boundlessness as they applied to his Mana and somewhat applied to his Dimensional Reality, but...it wasn't a word that truly defined who he was.
He was not boundless in this unfolding Kainos Era.
He was not interminable!
What he wanted to be in this unfolding Kainos Era...was an unmatched Emperor that others could not compare to.
He wanted to be an ideal embodiment of an Emperor of this Era as nobody could take his Throne from him!
When he thought of a word that could best relate to being the ideal embodiment of something...a single one came to mind.
"Quintessential."
HOOONG!
Vibrant storms of destiny began to rage the moment he uttered this word out loud.
Others in his position may have favored Tyrannical or Infinite.
But that was them, and he was him.
He was Noah Osmont, the...
"Quintessential Kainos Emperor."
WAA!
Quintessential meaning ideal, epitome, paragon, or the Embodiment of a Kainos Emperor!
He wanted to be the ideal embodiment of this Kainos Era.
Someone that other Emperors would gaze upon and instantly feel their inadequacy!
Instantly feel that they were wasting their time even competing with him!
For he would be the ideal Emperor of this current Era!
Of this current Age!
DIIING!
The storms of destiny picked up and became maddeningly tyrannical as Karma, Fortune, and Fate began to run wild as well.
They surged from his body that was situated upon the Throne of Quintessential Tyranny- the Throne that best exemplified Tyranny!
They surged outwards across the bounds of his Dimensional Holy Land.
Across the Infinite Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality.

chapters.title: Chapter 1883
paragraphs: <The Age of Quintessence has arrived!>
This message and authority buzzed in the minds of all Candidate Emperors across Realities and Dimensions as it termed the name of the current Age!
It also showed that destiny had reached a profound level as with every action- there had to have been something that had triggered it.
Those knowledgeable instinctively knew that something must have happened to bring to fruition the name of the First Age of the Kainos Era.
But as to whether one could correctly guess what exactly spurred all this? It was a sheer impossibility simply because nobody would be able to believe it!
Emperors of all creeds and factions surged as their wills awoke.

In the Main Reality, the Hegemony of Primordials reigned as existences with terrifying power woke, the countless Primordial Temples ringing with the air of change and chaos as they foretold of tumultuous times coming!
This foretelling was grand, but events were already unfolding at this moment as apart from the vast Realities- there were those residing in the 9 Dimensions and those lost in the continuum of time.
There were the Ancient Races that had been biding their time since the shifting of power of the Olden Era.

Those of the Ancient Races had ruled over the vast lands for an entire Era, their power being something undecipherable as the sheer fact they were toppled by the hands of a single being still remained the biggest mystery of Ages!

Even though they had their hegemony decimated, many of these Ancient Races still survived as they took refuge in far away reaches of Realities...and many took refuge in Dimensions where the hegemony of Primordials was not as prevalent.
Many formed new alliances in order to survive and thrive, with connections being formed with Dimensional Royalties and shockingly...even Dimensional Hellion Rulers!

There were then the Ancient Races who joined hands with the budding Race of Primordial Beasts who were the youngest amongst the warring Races in terms of history- and yet their power was undeniable as they had one thing on their side.
Reality itself.
The Enders of Reality, The Primordial Beasts...these existences had the very making of Reality supporting them and their advancement in order to return things to how they once were!
The extent of how much their power had grown since the splitting of the Main Reality was unknown, but they also moved with their own goals.
So when the name of the new Age was announced, these beings moved with even more fervor to accomplish their aims!
The granting of the name told them that Destiny was rising to its peak of this Age as in the coming times, Victors and Losers would be decided!
For the Primordial Beasts, they knew that if Reality did not go back the way it was since the past Era, it would more than likely never be returning to this state.

For the Ancient Races, they knew that if they could not topple the Hegemony of Primordials in the first Age of this Kainos Era...then it would become immeasurably hard to reverse the changes of power made in the Last Age of the Olden Era!

For the Primordials....they knew that the test of their Hegemony was coming as they simply had to keep the reigns of power in this Age of Quintessence, and they would more than likely reign for the years to come!
The Dimensional Royalties and Dimensional Hellion Rulers...their aims and goals were grand and influenced by something much greater as the 9 Dimensions held their restrictions for a reason.

They had a glorious purpose...but this purpose was slowly changing since the end of the Olden Era as the restrictions that held back Dimensions were ever so slowly loosened due to the actions of a single being!
So the competition of Emperors of this Age...would be unlike any other as the number and quality of existences involved were much greater than any of the past Ages of the Olden Era.
The time of Blood and War was here as the name of the new Age was digested by all beings.
The Age of Quintessence!
An Age where those fighting for supremacy had to show themselves to be the ideal embodiments of Emperors against all others!
Was this part of the reason why this Age gained this name? Because there were so many Candidate Emperors from so many different areas competing?
That all of these beings had to show which of them best exemplified the True Emperor of this Age?!
When trying to find the meaning of the name of this new Age and how best to proceed, many might come to this conclusion.
But they didn't know.
None of them knew...that there was an existence that was titled as the Quintessential Kainos Emperor already!
An existence who titles himself as the ideal embodiment of an Emperor not just of this Age...of this blooming Kainos Era!
So the Primordials moved with their own aims and goals.
Primordial Beasts and Ancient Races moved for their own hopes and Dreams!
Dimensional Royalties and Dimensional Hellion Rulers...they moved for glory and Conquest after having been reigned in and restricted for too long.
The First Age of the Kainos Era began like this.

The Age of Quintessence...bloomed from unknown means as while Candidate Emperors began to scramble on the path for supremacy, the Quintessential Kainos Emperor solidified his advancement as he gazed over all his new abilities while also pondering of this Age and his own distinction.

He sat on the Throne of Quintessential Tyranny as behind him, his spinning crown of ETHEREAL DIMENSIONAL EMPEROR remained the same, but his soul buzzed as it felt like there was something he could do now that he could not do before.

With his Tri-Pupiled Eyes, he released terrifying beams of light as his will surged, watching as the word ETHEREAL spinning above his crown fluctuated before an instant later, it changed to Quintessential!
Quintessential Dimensional Emperor!
WAA!
Essence erupted again as Noah's eyes flashed once more, and the first word changed yet again as it returned to ETHEREAL.

chapters.title: Chapter 1884
paragraphs: His description above his crown was malleable.

This was the conclusion Noah came to after switching ETHEREAL with QUINTESSENTIAL multiple times, where he could choose to display everything about him as people would come to know his title very much matched the current Age...or he could be just a tiny bit low key and not scream this out at the top of his lungs.
He wasn't the most powerful Kainos Emperor yet.

There were many more powerful beings and extremely old existences who had comprehended too many things, with his True Sanguine Clone about to face one very soon as before that battle unfolded, he had to acclimate and understand his new level of power.
With 120 Innate Ascendancy Halos and 10 from a TABOO Relic, what could his power reach?
With his now ridiculously 300% Innate Dimensional Barrier alone...how many Billions of Defense Values did he have?!
With the features of <Skill Succession> and <Concept Amalgamation>...just how much could he tweak his power?

Thinking of the new features of his Traits while his Paramount Kainos Dream Dimensional Reality stabilized and continued the budding of new Cosmos, Noah's thoughts were led to the remaining Trait he had yet to delve into.
The prompts had already come as it finished around the same time as the other two traits!
<The Authority of the Samsara Universal Dao Origin Trait has greatly increased.>
WAA!
Noah's eyes shone with a dazzling stellar luster as more prompts rained down!
<Repeat has been unlocked.>
<Samsara Dimensional Chassis has been unlocked.>
<The newly unlocked feature of Samsara Dimensional Chassis has been altered to Quintessential Dimensional Chassis.>
<Empyral Refiner has been unlocked.>
Concepts of stupendous glory came as amidst Noah's own distinction, one of them even had its name changed to fit Noah's current aims and goals.
And their descriptions...were just as glorious!

<Repeat>:: Having been anchored to the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality and resonating to establish your own Dimension, you gain the capability to return a day prior in the case of an Instant Death caused by TABOO authority, DHARMA Authority, or the authority of a Decretum. This ability is usable only in certain conditions and has a cooldown of 1 Month.

<Quintessential Dimensional Chassis>:: Your path forward has been established to be the formation of 9 Unique types of Dimensions in your Origin, with the Dream Dimensional Reality being the first Dimension. For this Dimension and all Dimensions that are to follow, a more quintessential authority can be granted to one of your True Sanguine Clones for them to attain a Quintessential Dimensional Chassis based on chosen Dimension. A Clone that has been granted this authority allows you to build that Dimension and understand its Decretum 10,000% faster, as well as make your understanding of the Natural Laws of Reality 10,000% faster. Abilities that utilize the Dimensional Essence of the chosen Dimension also have 100% increased Penetration against enemy's defenses. Your path past the 9 Dimension is undefined, perhaps the 9 Quintessential Dimensional Chassis can illuminate the path forward. Currently available Quintessential Dimensional Chassis to choose from: Quintessential Dream Dimensional Chassis.

<Empyral Refiner>:: Your Origin and Body share an extremely strong connection that has only become more quintessential after their resonance, yet your Origin is much more pristine than your body. To absolve this discrepancy, the Samsara Universal Dao Origin has given way to this passive ability that will increase the rate of refining your Bones, Organs, and Musculature towards their path to becoming EMPYRAL by 10,000%.
The Tri-Pupiled eyes of the Quintessential Kainos Emperor blazed like subs as they watched these abilities.
Repeat was ridiculous as it could bring him back 24 hours prior to a True Death once a month, even though he never planned on dying to anyone anytime soon!
Empyral Refiner was also just as fantastical as it made his pathways towards forming an astounding Empyral Foundation even more pristine in his new stage!
Then there was <Quintessential Dimensional Chassis>.
The word Chassis had appeared before as it meant body, framework, or skeleton.
In Noah's case, it meant being capable of granting his True Sanguine Clones a body that distinguished each one of his 9 future Layers of Dimensions.
9 Quintessential Dimensional Bodies!
, m And right now, Noah could designate one Clone to become the Embodiment of his First Layer- the Dream Dimensional Reality!
DIIING!
But before Noah could think about this any further, his Destiny buzzed powerfully as he was led to gaze at a skill he had gone past just now.
<Empyral Refiner>.
His destiny buzzed with power as it was showing a profound possibility with this ability...and something else!

Noah was slowly becoming more and more adept in Destiny as he very quickly picked up the hints and turned his attention towards another feature he had recently unlocked. It was <Concept Amalgamation>.
The capability to combine concepts together as it could be applied to Daos and Edicts and even abilities!

Noah's destiny informed him of a profound pathway filled of Fortune when the ability of <Empyral Refiner> appeared, hinting to him that there was another ability that would match extremely well with it were Noah to utilize Concept Amalgamation!
The answer was of course...
"Empyral Mitahara."
WAA!
Noah's will grasped onto the two concepts as with his destiny pointing the way forward so clearly, he didn't hesitate to see what would come from it.
"Concept Amalgamation."
The vibrant skies turned blue.

Pure Mana surged out in a show of shocking wonder as Noah felt parts of his Soul that were carrying two concepts together become wrapped in endless waves of Mana, their fundamental structure altered and elevated as they went towards fusion!
His Tri-Pupiled eyes released beams of cerulean blue Mana briefly as a magnificent scene bloomed, a new prompt rising before him soon after as seas of destiny raged.
<The skills Empyral Mitahara and Empyral Refiner have undergone the process of Amalgamation.>
<The Ascendant Kainos Ability Quintessential Empyral Kaiser is born!>

<Quintessential Empyral Kaiser>:: An Ascendant Kainos Ability that stands out amongst its peers, allowing for you to draw upon the nourishing Essence of the Infinite Reality Passages, Dimensional Essence, and spicules of the essence of the Natural Laws of Reality into it to achieve the effect of nourishing a selected Bone, Musculature, or Organ to begin transforming into the higher stage of Empyral. This is a passive ability that will increase the rate of refining your Bones, Organs, and Musculature towards their path to becoming EMPYRAL by 10,000%, and it holds no resource cost to activate or maintain...
The buzzing Essence in the surroundings lulled.
Quintessential came and stained as only Noah's luminous Tri-Pupiled glow could be seen.

As Noah was affirming his strength and beginning to use his newly unlocked ability, the first thing he brought to fruition was a passive ability that would cause all other beings to scream of the unfairness!

To absolve this discrepancy, the Samsara Universal Dao Origin has given way to this passive ability that will increase the rate of refining your Bones, Organs, and Musculature towards their path to becoming EMPYRAL by 10,000%.
The Tri-Pupiled eyes of the Quintessential Kainos Emperor blazed like subs as they watched these abilities.
Repeat was ridiculous as it could bring him back 24 hours prior to a True Death once a month, even though he never planned on dying to anyone anytime soon!
Empyral Refiner was also just as fantastical as it made his pathways towards forming an astounding Empyral Foundation even more pristine in his new stage!
Then there was <Quintessential Dimensional Chassis>.
The word Chassis had appeared before as it meant body, framework, or skeleton.
In Noah's case, it meant being capable of granting his True Sanguine Clones a body that distinguished each one of his 9 future Layers of Dimensions.
9 Quintessential Dimensional Bodies!
, m And right now, Noah could designate one Clone to become the Embodiment of his First Layer- the Dream Dimensional Reality!
DIIING!
But before Noah could think about this any further, his Destiny buzzed powerfully as he was led to gaze at a skill he had gone past just now.
<Empyral Refiner>.
His destiny buzzed with power as it was showing a profound possibility with this ability...and something else!
Noah was slowly becoming more and more adept in Destiny as he very quickly picked up the hints and turned his attention towards another feature he had recently unlocked.
It was <Concept Amalgamation>.
The capability to combine concepts together as it could be applied to Daos and Edicts and even abilities!

Noah's destiny informed him of a profound pathway filled of Fortune when the ability of <Empyral Refiner> appeared, hinting to him that there was another ability that would match extremely well with it were Noah to utilize Concept Amalgamation!
The answer was of course...
"Empyral Mitahara."
WAA!
Noah's will grasped onto the two concepts as with his destiny pointing the way forward so clearly, he didn't hesitate to see what would come from it.
"Concept Amalgamation."
The vibrant skies turned blue.

Pure Mana surged out in a show of shocking wonder as Noah felt parts of his Soul that were carrying two concepts together become wrapped in endless waves of Mana, their fundamental structure altered and elevated as they went towards fusion!
His Tri-Pupiled eyes released beams of cerulean blue Mana briefly as a magnificent scene bloomed, a new prompt rising before him soon after as seas of destiny raged.
<The skills Empyral Mitahara and Empyral Refiner have undergone the process of Amalgamation.>
<The Ascendant Kainos Ability Quintessential Empyral Kaiser is born!>

<Quintessential Empyral Kaiser>:: An Ascendant Kainos Ability that stands out amongst its peers, allowing for you to draw upon the nourishing Essence of the Infinite Reality Passages, Dimensional Essence, and spicules of the essence of the Natural Laws of Reality into it to achieve the effect of nourishing a selected Bone, Musculature, or Organ to begin transforming into the higher stage of Empyral.

This is a passive ability that will increase the rate of refining your Bones, Organs, and Musculature towards their path to becoming EMPYRAL by 10,000%, and it holds no resource cost to activate or maintain...
The buzzing Essence in the surroundings lulled.
Quintessential came and stained as only Noah's luminous Tri-Pupiled glow could be seen.

As Noah was affirming his strength and beginning to use his newly unlocked ability, the first thing he brought to fruition was a passive ability that would cause all other beings to scream of the unfairness!

chapters.title: Chapter 1885
paragraphs: Noah sat upon his Throne of Quintessential Tyranny as he gazed at the newly formed ability from Concept Amalgamation.
An ability that entirely erased the resource cost of Empyral Mitahara and brought forth a passive ability that Noah could keep active at all times!
An ability that would aid Noah in forging his unique Empyral Foundation in this stage as this was something even he was only beginning to delve into.

His Infinite Reality Passages that had risen to 90 buzzed as the Cycles of the Mythical Natural Born Infinite Dream Physique continued, Noah's Tri-Pupiled eyes gazing upon them as he spoke out lightly.
"Let the light of the Quintessential Empyral Kaiser rain down."
HUUUM!

The passive skill that had just bloomed activated as it would now always remain this way, the massive mountainous stellar golden Passages above Noah releasing tendrils of essence that washed over his body to begin the constant process of Refinement.

The tendrils seemed like magnificent swirling storms that spun towards Noah, each time they did this causing a reaction that pulled spicules of the Essence of Natural Laws of Reality into this mixture that went to refine Noah!
The spicules of essence of Natural Laws could shockingly be gathered by these unique Infinite Reality Passages as even they had undergone changes due to Noah's elevation.
Information about them quickly rose before Noah's eyes with the relevant prompts being pulled before him.

<Your Infinite Reality Passages have resonated with the advancement of your Paramount Kainos Dream Dimensional Reality, undergoing further evolution after your distinction as they have become [Infinite Quintessential Dimensional Reality Passages].>
Noah gazed at this prompt while nodding his head but also raising his brows because frankly, the names of the things attached to him seemed to be getting longer and more mouthful!
What was crucial to grasp from the new <Infinite Quintessential Dimensional Reality Passages> was just that they had become more in tune with the Dimensional aspect as due to this...
<The Decretum of the Dimensions you have forged in your Origin will be generated and nourish you amidst all other essences.>
<A single Infinite Quintessential Dimensional Reality Passage grants the generation of 60,000 Units of the Essence of Reality per second.>
<The Generation of all other Resources is vastly increased.>
An astounding increase in resource generation and what went on to further make the capability of Quintessential Empyral Kaiser possible.

The dazzling golden colored essence of the pristine Decretum of the Dream Dimension also went to bathe over Noah from his Reality Passages as along with the Essence of Natural Laws of Reality and the surging Mana around him...Noah began to feel his body burn!
Burn with power and awe that was asking him where?!
Where could the fantastical essence of Refinement start on first?
Of the Organs, Bones, and Musculature...where could one begin?!
Some would favor the brain as the most important part of the body that controlled everything.
Others would say the Heart as it pumped blood throughout.
Noah looked over all this as he instead gave a command for something else.
"Bones...illuminate and elevate the bone marrow."
WAA!
Through Bone Marrow! The place where one's very own life blood originated!
The vibrant surging essence sunk into Noah's body and went into the depths of chosen Bones, focusing on these in order to turn the core of bones where blood was generated to be EMPYRAL first!

It was a process that would take time as Noah didn't know exactly how much faster the 10,000% Modifier made things along with his own shocking foundation and Dimensional Reality Passages, but he did not doubt that it would merely be a matter of days if not weeks at most.
Other beings needed thousands or even millions of years if they were not talented enough, but why would the Quintessential Kainos Emperor need such a long period of time?!
He would exemplify himself the most in this Era as the being who can forge his Empyral Foundation the quickest out of all others!
A shocking air of tyranny erupted with this thought as multicolored waves of essence permeated throughout.
As this process began, Noah then turned his eyes towards the many TABOO concepts in his soul and the fact that he needed to establish 60 new Ascendancy Halos.

He had to finish his preparations and be ready to not just face the terrifying portion of a soul stemming from a Dimensional Hellion Ruler- but he needed to have the power to completely dominate and eradicate it!
Because of this, his preparations had to truly be stupendous as he should definitely continue using the boons he recently received.
<Concept Amalgamation>
BZZT!
His will surged once more as he called forth this skill, the target this time being the many, many TABOO Edicts he had gained from his enemies.
"Isolate those that are compatible and birth Ascendant TABOO Nomological Edicts."

The Edicts of others beings were always lesser than his in terms of power and uniqueness, but Noah went ahead to elevate them by combining compatible ones as he would put 60 Ascendant TABOO Nomological Edicts in each Ascendancy Halo!
And this process...was not one that consumed too much time as these Edicts had already been Corrupted by RUINATION as they only received another baptism.
Prompts began to rise before Noah's eyes in no time.
<The TABOO Nomological Edicts of the Flameborn and Nuclear Emperor have undergone the process of Amalgamation.>
<The Ascendant TABOO Nomological Edict Celestial Flame Emperor is born!>
<The TABOO Nomological Edicts of the....>

Thousands of prompts like this were pushed away by Noah's mind as they told of the birth of thousands of Ascendant TABOO Nomological Edicts in a short period of time, Noah observing their changes and wonders as thereafter, he began filling in the blank Ascendancy Halos.
From the 70 that he was currently fused with, the 71st Halo soon formed!
HOONG!

It shone with an immensely darker obsidian color that released a glint of a crimson light, the authority of this Halo being vastly different compared to the previous ones as it was a Halo that first contained only TABOO Edicts...and these TABOO Edicts were all combined together as they had the <Ascendant> distinction before them.
Naturally, their authority was grand!

chapters.title: Chapter 1886
paragraphs: <Ascendant Black Ascendancy Halo>:: An accumulation of the authority of Flames of Ascendant TABOO Nomological Edicts that grants a multiplier of 200x when used alone. When fused to attain the strongest Quintessential Kainos Emperor True Form, every 10 Ascendant Black Halos grant a base 1,000x multiplier, and the Quintessential Kainos Emperor True Form grants an additional 5,000x multiplier per 10 Ascendancy Halos. In this Form, the resource cost of abilities is reduced by half as the Damage Values can be altered from Physical to Soul, Reality to Dimensional, and vice versa. Abilities cast under this authority carry a trace of dominance and oppression as lesser abilities are entirely cancelled or dispersed under their tyranny...
A ridiculous boost in multipliers that would only make Noah's dreams arrive faster bloomed before him at this moment!
The base boost per 10 Halos used to be 500.
The additional multiplier boost from his True Form used to be 2,500!
Now...these numbers just obscenely went and doubled.
For his strongest True Form that he could now maintain at all times due to the wonders of Ascendant Dimensional Shards, he could have a total of 6,000 per 10 Ascendancy Halos.
For 130 Ascendant Black Tier Halos, that was a maddening grand total of 78,000x multiplier!

A multiplier that after he quantified his base Damage and Defense Values boosts that towered past 30,000 after his new Origin alone ridiculously granted 20,000....would put his Damage Values past 2.3 Billion.
And when multiplied by 2 due to the Throne of Quintessential Tyranny...any of his hits could easily dish out close to 5 Billion Damage Values!
Now...let's keep our hearts steady as we go a bit further and observe the Defense Values.
As we observe the Innate Dimensional Barrier that Noah could attain 300% of his maximum defense value in his strongest form.

Keeping the same base value and multiplier would mean 2.3 Billion Innate Defense Values as the multiplier of the Throne was not Innate and not counted...Noah's Innate Dimensional Barrier alone protected him with 7 Billion True Dimensional Defense Values!

Now if he just cast a Defense Skill like the Lich's Armament of Devotion that was affected by the True Dual Enhancement of the Throne of Quintessential Tyranny and could also be considered an active skill Noah could keep at all times due to its resource cost being nullified...this alone would grant Noah close to 5 Billion Defense Values that when added to his Innate Dimensional Barrier that granted 7 Billion, Noah had officially reached the cusp of weak Alpha Strata LEGENDS.
Yes.

Beta Stratas could deal Damage Values ranging in the Hundreds of Millions to a few Billion depending on the extent of their power, while those at the Alpha Strata were capable of dishing out at least 10 Billion in Damage Values!
Noah's Defense alone spilled over this number as weak Alpha Strata LEGENDS...would not even be capable of touching him.
Ah!
Even Noah clicked his tongue at this as he made a prayer for any of his future enemies.
For any being that just did not know what was coming!
Because even he....has a ridiculous ability of <I Am The Main Character> that had question marks as he himself didn't understand what it entailed!

As he thought about all this and began forging his new Ascendancy Halos while rebuilding his old ones with Ascendant TABOO Nomological Edicts, Noah didn't yet make the jump on his strongest Edicts in terms of Concept Amalgamation as for now, he prepared to learn about his enemy.

He prepared to understand just what ridiculous power he would be facing in the Kun Peng's Cataclysm Nest when it came to the portion of a soul of a being who should be able to utilize a Decretum of a Dimension if not multiple Dimensions, DHARMA Tier Edicts...and even possibly Natural Laws!
What would his Tri-Pupiled Eyes be able to discover?
What exactly was the Dimensional Deceiver's culminated value of Destiny, Fate, Karma, and Fortune? Her True Vitality Values? Maximum Resources?!

As he acclimated to his new body and still experimented with his newly unlocked concepts, his will turned back to the Kun Peng's Cataclysm Nest where the Defiler of Souls was still completing her transformation by taking over Genevieve's body- not even a microsecond having passed.

His True Sanguine Clone still gave off calm waves of contained power as this Clone...was actually the prime candidate to be made the Quintessential Dream Dimensional Chassis body, but Noah waited to see just how scalable or unscalable a Dimensional Hellion Ruler was before completing setting his mind on this!
And for him to understand just how vast the discrepancy was in terms of power and Destiny, Noah had to have points of comparison.

So while the Dimensional Deceiver finished her transformation, the eyes of Noah's True Sanguine Clone flashed as the pupils attained three pupils, his will surging to gaze upon the figures of Primordials around him!

He wanted to attain the basic understanding of the quantification of power from the lowest beings to the highest, so he started with an existence that was fairly considered a somewhat above average genius in the Primordial Dragon Phoenix Lineage- Aegon who was currently frozen fearfully around the Young Emperor behind the protection of Ezekiel and the Decretum of the Avalon Dimension that wrapped around him.
<Name>: Aegon
<Lineage>: Dragon Phoenix
<Realm>: Reality(Newly Forged)
<Titles>: Golden Child, Dragonlance...
<True Reality Vitality Values>: 6 Million
<Innate Primogenial Barrier>: 5 Million
<Reserves of Essence of Reality>: 350,000
<Mana>: 1 Trillion
<Destiny>: 5 <Fate>: 5 <Fortune>...
<Overall Battlepower>: Beginner Primogenial Strata
Noah's blazing eyes quickly saw information rise above the head of this so called geniuses in a glimmering white text box as everything about him seemed abysmal!

His Fate and Destiny were on the lower rungs of things with a value of 5 for all, while his True Vitality Values or what would commonly be known as one's 'Health'- it was only at the basic levels for beginner LEGENDS.

There were other points of information that rose up about him, but Noah only quickly perused them before moving on. He ascertained this basic level as he then went to a slightly higher comparator- his gaze landing on the stern figure of the existence from the Avalon Dimension.
Lancelot!
Unlike Aegon, a golden text box rose up above this being's head.
<Name>: Ezekiel/Lancelot
<Lineage>: Avalon/Dragon Phoenix
<Realm>: Cosmic Filament
<Titles>: King's Knight, Royal Emperor,...
<True Dimensional Vitality Values>: 70 Million(+300 Million)
<Innate Primogenial Barrier>: 6 Million(+90 Million)
<Reserves of Essence of Reality>: 3,750,000
<Mana>: 95 Trillion
<Destiny>: 50 <Fate>: 55 <Fortune>...
<Overall Battlepower>: Beginner Beta Strata
An existence at the Ninth Firmament of Ascendancy who could reach power equivalent to the Beta Strata!

His levels of Destiny and Fate were at the halfway point, with Noah still not being able to get a good grasp of the quantification of these Values as comparing them to Aegon, Ezekiel was more than ten times more blessed with an abundant destiny and Fortune.

His Vitality Values were already astounding at a base of 70 Million as even beginner LEGENDS couldn't touch him, but it was made more obscene by an outside boost that could be attributed to his Decretum of the Avalon Dimension or another unique Trait as he was granted an additional 300 Million Vitality Values to be capable of withstanding Beta Strata LEGENDS! And due to being a Limit Breaker, he also had his own unique Innate Barrier as his overall stats were not to be looked down upon.
After getting these two comparators, Noah turned to himself this time around as his Tri-Pupiled eyes blazed their authority onto himself!
<Name>: Noah Osmont
<Lineage>: Quintessential Kainos Emperor
<Realm>: Dimensional Reality(1st Layer)
<Titles>: Tyrannical Emperor, Apex Paragon...
<True Dimensional Vitality Values>: 25 Billion
<Innate Primogenial Barrier>: 7 Billion
<Reserves of Essence of Reality>: 20,000,000
<Mana>: Undefined
<Destiny>: Undefined <Fate>: Undefined...
<Overall Battlepower>: Potential Alpha Strata
Noah's hard work and efforts were laid down in a magisterial obsidian gold text box that placed him in the ranks of monstrous existences!

chapters.title: Chapter 1887
paragraphs: The surging waves of mana calmed in Lavalliere's eyes as she observed the unfolding play before her.
The being she had bound herself to had truly done what he sought to do as he established the First Layer of the 9 Layers of Dimensions that he set as his path.
And now, he boldly went to face an existence that made even Emperors of Dimensions somber- an existence with the identity of a Dimensional Hellion Ruler!

Yes, she was merely an insignificant part of a soul whose will controlled an EMPYRAL appendage. But...her intricacies and understanding of Decretums of Dimensions nor Natural Laws did not fade! Even when restricted, they could still be deployed somewhat as battle at the level of these beings was entirely different compared to those below them.
Today, Noah would experience a new type of battle he wasn't privy to before while facing the Dimensional Deceiver.

Lavalliere gazed at the same golden obsidian stat panel that was brought up from his Tri-Pupiled eyes as she continued to be amazed in silence for the level of power Noah had managed to achieve in such a short period of time.
Power that would take others millions of years if not more!
The Values he held were all top tier as some...were purely ridiculous at his level.
25 Billion True Dimensional Vitality Values.

A Value that even average Alpha Strata LEGENDS didn't have as how did he attain it? Did he even know the constant nourishing of his body through his massive Passages, the constant branding of VITALITY ecritures that had only become increasingly faster, and his constant fusion of all his bloodlines into a single one...did he know it would result in all this?
For his body to be so sturdy and unshakable that his life force was this obscene?!

This wasn't all as the skill that he had nullified the resource cost of through another ridiculous method, the Lich's Armament of Devotion...it granted 20% Strata Vitality Regeneration every microsecond.
Nearly a fourth of the ridiculous 25 Billion True Dimensional Vitality Values that were much greater and more robust than True Reality Vitality Values would be regenerated every microsecond.
What a ridiculous existence this being was!
<And just like your Life Line, your Destiny, Fate, Karma, and Fortune are Undefined...>
A simple numerical number placing Noah in a specific group did not rise even from the shocking eyes of the Tri-Pupiled Kainos Emperor.
But what of the enemy he currently faced?
What of the existence that had caused everything to fold and stop as time itself seemed to have been influenced and nullified?
Lavalliere's will followed Noah's eyes that flashed with dazzling radiance that went on to land on the curvaceous figure taking form.
Of the amalgamation of Genevieve and the will of a Dimensional Hellion Ruler!

It couldn't truly even be called an amalgamation as the capacity of Genevieve's soul could not remain itself under the tyranny of an existence that controlled countless forces and reigned their influence over three dimensions.
Her body had grown massive and grandiose, the visage of Lillith imposing itself onto Genevieve as fantastical beauty that she couldn't even imagine reigned down.
A body so curvaceous and sculpted, with eyes letting out a chilling deadly light of coldness and confidence as vicious crimson gold blood surged around her to adorn an exquisite battledress!
Her head had four horns rising upwards symmetrically, 100 dazzling Ascendancy Halos having been bound to these horns as they released domineering power.
Some of these Halos were a pristine black as they represented TABOO, and a few...were supremely crimson.
Crimson!
A color of Halos only Noah had been able to display so far due to his authority as the Sanguine Emperor!
Lillith displayed it so easily as whatever restrictions bound her, it seemed that she could still utilize at least a semblance of her DHARMA Tier Edicts.

Above her, a thousand stellar crimson Reality Passages were enacted as they seemed to be gushing down resplendent rivers of blood towards her, her power being heart shaking as above everyone- only the Luminous Heart of Destiny that was still awaiting a new owner remained unblemished from her overpowering light!

On her right hand, the EMPYRAL appendage had fused with her, and yet it didn't show the vibrant gold as it seemed to have melded into her body completely as she only showed her vibrant fair skin wrapped up in the bloody crimson battledress, even more vibrant wings akin to that of a butterfly rising up behind her.
The two words that could describe her were beautiful and utterly dreadful.
The Dimensional Deceiver!
Her very looks and movements could also be nothing but deception!
At this moment, her transformation finished as her eyes opened to reveal beast like pupils- the eyes of a predator that considered everything below it as its prey.
DIIING!
A bloody text box rose up as the words within were inlaid with dazzling gold.
<Name>: Genevieve(Lillith)???
<Lineage>: ???
<Realm>: Reality
<Titles>: The Dimensional Deceiver...
<True Dimensional Vitality Values>: 100 Billion
<Innate Primogenial Barrier>: 10 Billion
<Reserves of Essence of Reality>: 50,000,000
<Mana>: 500 Trillion
<Destiny>: 75 <Fate>: ???...
<Overall Battlepower>: Alpha Strata and Beyond
Lavalliere gazed at the same numbers Noah saw as she remained silent.
At least this made sense to her mind!

She didn't know if this was a decimal percentage worth of the True power of Lillith that reigned over Dimensions, but at least it made sense! Not like the capabilities of an existence who had just begun to move for over a year...and yet he also held a semblance of power similar to a portion of the Will of a Dimensional Hellion Ruler!
But what the Tri-Pupiled Eyes showed were merely the surface value.

The Edicts, understanding of any Natural Laws, and Decretums of Dimensions...these superseded the numerical values shown before Noah's eyes as Lavalliere's voice buzzed into his mind in the next moment.
<Be careful.>
She knew she couldn't dissuade him from his thoughts and actions.
His Bloodline was too tyrannical for that! But she could at least prepare him for what was to come.
The moment her words finished, the cold eyes of Lillith that just opened instantly focused on Noah.
She didn't say any words or introduce herself or make any unneeded movements!
She only raised her hand and turned her index finger upwards.

A simple motion...and yet everything in the surroundings began to buzz as multicolored radiance burst forth, what had frozen everyone in time dissipating as instead- a profound authority surged out to cover the vast stretches of glacial cold lands.
Lavalliere's soul buzzed when she saw this blooming authority!
This...was the authority of a Natural Law of Reality.

chapters.title: Chapter 1888
paragraphs: Lillith only pointed her index finger upwards!

But in the next moment, an undeniable storm of vibrant multicolored authority bloomed and surged out like a whirling stellar sea, the millions of Primogenial LEGENDS and dozens of Beta Strata LEGENDS finding themselves uncontrollably rising from the ground as their bodies began spin across the skies.
Like a shocking wide range storm of authority, it affected everything as even the Pure-Blooded Primordial Geniuses rose and began to spin from the far distance they were at!
"OOOOH!"

A shocking radiance burst forth from the visage of Ezekiel as the Decretum of the Avalon Dimension erupted from him, barely bursting out its authority and holding him anchored to his position as it went on to cover as many Primordials as it could.
Akaris had her shield domain shockingly reject the authority of this Natural Law as she remained utterly still!

Katelyn...was beside Noah as a shocking golden grandeur had erupted from him at this moment, keeping his position and her position stable in the skies as Katelyn even had her own surging silver essence ready to protect her.

But the rest of the battlefield...had LEGENDS uncontrollably spinning in the skies as the shocking force of rotation was unlike any storms, the authority called out being too pristine as one could see tens of thousands of Primogenial LEGENDS having their bodies squeezed as if they faced a horrific pressure on all sides!

Those closest to the eruption of this authority didn't even fare a microsecond as their bodies were shockingly pressed down on and compressed into a terrifying cluster of blood...blood that then turned into rivers and began flowing towards none other than the Blood Empress.
The Defiler of Souls!
Her actions were erratic and incomprehensible as where was she after she turned the whole battlefield into a scrambling mess?
One would only have to follow the surging rivers of blood from tens of thousands of Primogenial LEGENDS of the Ancient Races that only had their death toll climbing higher to see her position.
And shockingly, she had traversed and covered vast distances to appear instantly a few meters before Noah as the very space seemed to be squeezed and bent wherever she moved!

Her devilishly curvaceous visage retained utmost coldness as her body gained even more increased authority and power- the vibrant rivers of crimson gold blood flowing into her butterfly like bloody wings in a show of shocking glory!
Dimensional Hellion Rulers were some of the most perceptive and powerful existences as they did not play around.
The first move that Lillith made was to turn everything utterly chaotic as she unfurled her control over a shocking Natural Law of Reality.

Lavalliere recognized it from a long time ago before she was stripped of too many things. Just knowing its identity was a boon for her at this moment as she uttered out her thoughts loud for even Noah to hear!
<The Natural Law of Gravitation.>
WAA!
The Natural Law of Gravitation.
A law that was part of the many fundamental concepts that reigned over the fabrics of Realities and Dimensions.

It imposed a simple concept upon the vast realities and dimensions- a concept that could be seen when an apple fell from a tree, when existences remained anchored on a vibrant earth while the stellar body they were on rotated across space...all the way to the revolutions of Cosmos in an Origin. To the mysteries of the formation of the first ever Runic Ecriture of Modus Operandi!

It stated that the most minute molecules or atoms attracted every other molecule or atom across the vast realities and dimensions with a force that was directly proportional to the product of the masses of said objects...and inversely proportional to the square of the distance between said objects!
And when an existence learned of the Natural Law of Gravitation and could actually manipulate it...the results were wondrous and horrific at the same time as they unveiled themselves at this moment.

Lillith crushed the bodies of Primogenial Strata LEGENDS into rivers of blood as she whipped the rest into a frenzied storm as millions spun across the skies uncontrollably, while her attention remained on none other than Noah as she focused the terrifying authority of this Natural Law onto him.
To defend against the incomprehensible authority of a Natural Law, one must utilize the same one to dispel the effects or another Natural Law...or a ruling that helped keep together a Dimension!
A Decretum of a Dimension.

It was just blooming within Noah as he hadn't even attained its full description, but he had to pull out its essence at this moment to stop the descending authority that threatened to crush everything.
The Authority of the Natural Law of Gravitation!
BOOOM!

Different authorities clashed as a shocking impact bloomed, the gravitational force in the surroundings that kept together the very fabric of Reality turning wild as existences found themselves flung across uncontrollably!

The Dimensional Hellion Ruler had made her move as she shockingly devoured the blood of the armies of the being who had brought her here to recover even more strength, and Noah made his own moves at this moment.
With a face of utmost seriousness, he knew what he had to do!
Against the raging glory of even a portion of the Will of a Dimensional Hellion Ruler, he was undaunted!
He was fearless!
At this moment, time slowed as a shocking phenomenon bloomed.
In the chaotic surroundings, a melody began to resound as Noah's body was building up its authority.
A melody of valor and battle that caused one's heart to burn- all of it culminating into the sounds of booming drums and horns that began to emanate a glorious Symphony!
It was...Protagonist's Symphony!
It sounded like the symphony one would hear during a perilous battle.
A symphony that began to play when everything seemed for naught as a main character was about to lose everything!
It was the sound of horns and drums of victory as that blared out all around and even caused the visage of Lillith to gaze around briefly!
The Demoralized Side Character debuff descended on all enemies.
The Chosen Extra Buff was granted to all allies!
Meanwhile, Noah himself also gained +25% Increased Damage and Defense Values, Resource Generation, Vitality Regeneration, and Cast and Movement Speed as he heard his own Symphony!
His will and authority surged as he called upon one of the newly unlocked features from his Trait of Infinite Mana.
It was the feature of Skill Succession.

<Skill Succession>:: When casting an ability, a second ability can be linked to it to be cast at the same time as the second ability's resource cost is replaced by pure Mana. Compatible abilities can bring forth unexpected resonance and greatly increase the Damage of linked abilities.
Noah's surging will went on to select a few interesting combinations as for the current situation...
"Apply Skill Succession to Ascendant Reality Sever and Ascendant Illuminating Soul Star."
Lillith, the Blood Empress, was continuously getting stronger as she quite literally grounded powerful LEGENDS into rivers of blood and swallowed them....and Noah could not allow this to continue.
So, a shocking Succession of skills was born at this moment!
